stories.headline: OpenAI launches Dots: always-on AI agents powered by GPT-6 Astra
Nvidia approves $235 billion buyback, largest in US history
Anthropic has agreements to pay SpaceX $84.5 billion for compute
Grok and Gemini now power the US government's official AI website
SpaceX deploys all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, all running normally
Builder ships self-improving AI agents for WhatsApp and Telegram

caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from a new GPT-6 Astra agent to Nvidia's $235 billion buyback

OpenAI launched Dots, always-on AI agents powered by GPT-6 Astra, built to handle tasks for you around the clock.
Nvidia approved a $235 billion stock buyback, the biggest in US history, after adding $150 billion to its existing repurchase program.
Anthropic has agreements to pay SpaceX up to $84.5 billion for NVIDIA-based computing power through 2029.
Grok and Gemini now power America.gov, the US government's new AI site where anyone can get answers straight from official sources.
SpaceX deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, all operating normally.
One builder launched AI personal agents for WhatsApp and Telegram that learn how you work and handle the heavy lifting for you.

AI just moved in every direction at once. Labs are locking in hundreds of billions in computing deals, a new generation of always-on agents is live today, and AI is now wired into the US government. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, SpaceX, xAI
